app.description: The browser your AI agent drives for you: tabs, file uploads of any size, tidy downloads, iPhone version per site.
address.placeholder: Enter an address or a search
mobile.turnOff: Back to the desktop version for {site}
mobile.caption: iPhone version
keychain.tooltip: Fill in this site's sign-in from the Keychain
keychain.none: No sign-in for {site} in the Keychain.
keychain.accountOnly: Account {account} entered. Go to the next step to fill in the password.
keychain.denied: Filling cancelled: approval was not given.
keychain.noField: No sign-in field on this page.
keychain.error: Unable to read the Keychain. Try again, then check that the login keychain is unlocked.
menu.addKeychain: Add a Sign-in to the Keychain…
about.title: About wCLAUDE
about.toolkit: Part of the DESKTOP MAC TOOLKIT.
about.origin: Built with Electron and Chromium, not affiliated with their authors.
settings.title: Settings
settings.mobileHint: These sites always open with the screen, browser and touch input of an iPhone.
settings.mobileEmpty: No sites yet. Use the iPhone button in the toolbar on a site.
settings.downloadsHint: Every downloaded file is saved in this folder.
upd.autoHint: Updates are checked once a day. An update is installed when wCLAUDE quits, never while an agent is acting.
upd.available: Version {version} is available. You have version {current}.
upd.ready: Version {version} will be installed when wCLAUDE quits.
upd.busy: Installation postponed: an agent is acting. Try again in a moment.
upd.error: Unable to reach GitHub. Check the connection and that the gh tool is signed in, then try again.
upd.verifyFailed: The update failed the signature checks. Nothing was changed.
upd.title: wCLAUDE update
kcadd.title: Add a Sign-in to the Keychain
kcadd.intro: The sign-in is saved in your macOS Keychain. wCLAUDE only fills it in after your approval, given with your login password, and the AI agent never sees the password.
kcadd.missing: Enter the site, the username and the password.
kcadd.error: Unable to save to the Keychain. Check that it is unlocked, then try again.
settings.agentHint: Any MCP-compatible agent (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI…) connects to wCLAUDE through its MCP server. Control is only open to programs on this Mac.
settings.agentAllow: Allow control by an AI agent
settings.agentAllowHint: Takes effect the next time wCLAUDE starts.
settings.copied: Configuration copied. Paste it into your agent's MCP settings.
handoff.title: {agent} is waiting for you
handoff.kind.signin: Sign in in the wCLAUDE window, then click DONE.
handoff.kind.captcha: The site asks for a human check. Do it in the wCLAUDE window, then click DONE.
handoff.kind.blocked: The site blocks access. Unblock it in the wCLAUDE window if you can, then click DONE.
handoff.kind.other: Do the requested action in the wCLAUDE window, then click DONE.
settings.youtubeHint: wCLAUDE uses the official YouTube API: uploads of any size, titles, thumbnails and statistics, without going through the web page.
settings.youtubeHow: OAuth key: in Google Cloud, enable “YouTube Data API v3” and “YouTube Analytics API”, create an OAuth client ID of type “Desktop app”, then paste its ID and secret below, or choose the downloaded JSON file.
settings.youtubeClient: OAuth key: saved in the Keychain
settings.youtubeWaiting: Allow wCLAUDE in your browser, then come back here.
settings.youtubeError: Connecting to YouTube failed. Try again, and check that your account is listed among the OAuth key's test users.
settings.youtubeBadFile: This file is not a Google OAuth key. Choose the JSON file downloaded from Google Cloud.
yt.pageOk: wCLAUDE is connected to YouTube. You can close this tab.
yt.pageFail: Connecting to YouTube did not succeed. Go back to wCLAUDE to try again.
settings.youtubeBadValues: The client ID must end with .apps.googleusercontent.com, and the client secret cannot be empty.
settings.youtubeNeedsReconnect: Subtitles need one more permission: click Reconnect YouTube and approve in your browser.
settings.iconHint: Where wCLAUDE appears. In the menu bar, click the icon to show or hide the window, right-click it for its menu.
settings.autoStart: Open wCLAUDE at login, in the background
settings.autoStartHint: wCLAUDE starts hidden when you log in, always ready for agents, and restarts by itself if it stops unexpectedly. Quitting wCLAUDE stops it until your next login.
settings.autoStartDev: Only available in the installed app.
watch.title: Watch
watch.tooltip: Open the watch: the pages, feeds and repositories wCLAUDE checks for you
watch.status.needs_user: Needs you: sign-in or check to do yourself
watch.emptyText: Add pages, RSS feeds or GitHub repositories: wCLAUDE checks them while you are away and notes what changed. Your AI agent reads the digest when it comes back.
watch.needsUserHelp: Open the page, sign in or pass the check, then click Check now. wCLAUDE never gets around these protections.
watch.removeConfirm: Remove the source "{name}" and its items?
watch.f.name: Name
watch.f.hint: wCLAUDE reads the page on this Mac. No account, nothing is sent.
watch.badUrl: Invalid address: enter a web page (https://…).
watch.testNeedsUser: The page asks for a sign-in or a check. Open it in a tab, do it yourself, then test again.
watch.testNoZone: Area not found on the page: check the selector or leave the field empty.
watch.testFeed: RSS feed found, read in {seconds} s: {count} posts.
watch.testGithub: GitHub releases read in {seconds} s: {count}, the latest is {version}.
watch.testVersion: Page read in {seconds} s: highest version {version}.
watch.testReference: This reading is the reference, no alert for now.
settings.watchHint: wCLAUDE checks your sources while it is open (the menu bar keeps it running) and notes what is new for your AI agent. No AI inside the app, no protection bypassed.
import.title: Session import
import.done: {count} cookies imported from {browser} (Google and {site}). You are signed in with the same account as in {browser}.
import.none: No Google session found in {browser}. Sign in to Google in {browser} first, then try again.
import.error.denied: Access to the {browser} key in the Keychain was denied. Try again and click “Allow” in the macOS window.
import.error.nokey: The {browser} key was not found in the Keychain. Open {browser} once, then try again.
import.error.perm: macOS blocks reading {browser} data. Turn on wCLAUDE in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access, then quit and relaunch wCLAUDE.
mdown.tooltip: Download this page's video or audio with mDOWN
mdown.sent: Sent to mDOWN (with this site's session).
mdown.noPage: Open a web page to download it with mDOWN.
mdown.off: mDOWN isn't responding. Start the app.
settings.mdownHint: mDOWN is a video and audio downloader from the DESKTOP MAC TOOLKIT. Once linked, wCLAUDE gets an "mDOWN" button and agents get a tool to download the open page with the site's session.
settings.mdownFound: mDOWN is installed on this Mac.
mdown.disabled: The mDOWN link is turned off: turn it on in wCLAUDE settings.
